data.navTitle: 多孔材料、纤维近照与渗透对照
data.title: Drops across three pieces of cloth
data.goal: Drops across three pieces of cloth

memoryNodes.cue: A close-up shows a small pore.
A fiber runs through the fabric.
Water behaves differently on each sample.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 水在各样本上的表现不同。

data.situation:
Three material samples lay behind the glass. One was porous, with a close-up of a pore beside it. A second photograph traced an individual fiber through a piece of cloth. In the recorded test, water passed through a permeable sample but stayed on the coated one. A drop could permeate the untreated fabric rather than remaining on its surface. The last label identified one constituent of the synthetic material. Maya wrote down what each sample did when water touched it. Jo resisted guessing from appearance alone; a smooth surface could hide a different structure underneath. Jo: Can I tell if it is permeable just by looking?
Attendant: Compare the recorded tests as well.
Maya: This label lists a constituent.
Attendant: Yes. It names part of the material, not its entire structure.

readingBlocks.en: Three material samples lay behind the glass. One was porous, with a close-up of a pore beside it. A second photograph traced an individual fiber through a piece of cloth. In the recorded test, water passed through a permeable sample but stayed on the coated one. A drop could permeate the untreated fabric rather than remaining on its surface. The last label identified one constituent of the synthetic material. Maya wrote down what each sample did when water touched it. Jo resisted guessing from appearance alone; a smooth surface could hide a different structure underneath.
readingBlocks.zh: 玻璃后三块材料样本排开。一块多孔，旁边附有小孔特写。第二张照片沿布中的一根纤维展示其形态。录制测试中，水穿过可渗透样本，却留在覆膜样本上。水滴能渗入未经处理的织物，而不是只停在表面。最后一张标签指出合成材料中的一个组成成分。玛雅记下各样本遇水的表现，乔没有只凭外观猜测；光滑表面下也可能有不同结构。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Can I tell if it is permeable just by looking?
Attendant: Compare the recorded tests as well.
Maya: This label lists a constituent.
Attendant: Yes. It names part of the material, not its entire structure.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：只看就能判断它可渗透吗？
工作人员：还要比较录制测试。
玛雅：标签列出一个成分。
工作人员：是的，它说的是材料的一部分，不是完整结构。

glossary.note: 多孔的；能否让某种流体通过，还需看具体材料。

externalEvidence.definition: full of pores or vessels or holes

glossary.zh: 材料或表面中的细小孔隙
glossary.note: 这里是材料的小孔；pore over 则表示仔细阅读。

externalEvidence.definition: any tiny hole admitting passage of a liquid (fluid or gas)

glossary.note: 美式 fiber，英式 fibre；synthetic fibers 是合成纤维。
glossary.example: A fiber ran through the cloth.

externalEvidence.definition: a slender and greatly elongated substance capable of being spun into yarn

glossary.zh: 允许液体或气体透过的；可渗透的
glossary.note: permeable to water：水可以透过的。
glossary.example: Water passed through the permeable sample.

externalEvidence.definition: allowing fluids or gases to pass or diffuse through

glossary.zh: 渗入并穿过或遍布材料
glossary.note: water permeates the material：水渗入材料。
glossary.example: A drop could permeate the untreated fabric.
glossary.exampleZh: 水滴能渗入未经处理的织物。

glossary.note: 组成部分；a constituent of a material。
glossary.example: The label named one constituent of the material.
glossary.exampleZh: 标签指出材料的一个成分。

externalEvidence.definition: something determined in relation to something that includes it

glossary.zh: 通过人工化学过程制成的；合成的
glossary.example: The final sample was a synthetic material.

externalEvidence.definition: not of natural origin; prepared or made artificially
